name: ConfigureSourceScope
pure_preflight: probe source read-only and compute SourceScopeIdentityV1 reconciliation preview/fingerprint
transaction_boundary: one LLD-01 UnitOfWork; external source probe is repeated/validated before UoW and exact probe/reconciliation fingerprint is revalidated inside command without writing external store
guards: path-independent scope identity decision is unambiguous/reviewed
selected folder keys exist in current probe
receipt_order: replay -> re-probe/revalidate preview -> insert command_receipt -> scope/folder/event writes -> audit/results -> commit
revision_effects: create revision=1; material update increments scope revision; semantic no-change returns NO_CHANGE
post_commit_work: scheduler recomputes future eligibility; configuration alone never starts Deep Scan
